name: Book of Vikings

features.name: Expanding symbol
features.description: A random symbol expands across reels during free spins.

features.name: Norse theme
features.description: Vikings, longships and helmets replace the usual Egyptian icons.

review:
The book mechanic sails to Scandinavia: a 5x3, 10-line game with helmets, longships and warriors.

Free spins bring an expanding symbol, chosen at the start, that spreads across whole reels to complete wins on any line. No unusual extras – just the classic format done well, with a 5,500x max that's slightly higher than most book games. 96.5% RTP. Great if you like books but are tired of Egypt.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
